marta: Opening a tiny docs PR: SUSE on‑prem quickstart for Private — includes SoftHSM PKCS#11 example, nftables persistence, and an air‑gapped checklist. Need quick review on wording and commands.

samira: Please add a one‑line migration note for iptables -> nftables and link to our compat page.

naveen: Don’t hardcode iface names. Use <mgmt-iface> placeholder and show a SUSE example with ens192. Also add the SoftHSM init command.

marta: Will use placeholder + SUSE example. Adding SoftHSM snippet and this init command: `softhsm2-util --init-token --free --label "redwood-hsm" --pin 1234 --so-pin 5678`.

samira: Add a two-line airgap checklist at top: include SoftHSM RPM + deps, include nftables package + systemd unit.

docbot: Link check: flagged docs/internal/old-hsm-setup — recommend docs/security/hsm-provisioning. Also lint: use bash code fence for nft snippet.

marta: Thanks — fixing links and fences, updating PR now. Will ping when pushed. :white_check_mark:
